title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 30
description: Ten questions on Exodus 30: the incense altar, the atonement money, the bronze basin, the anointing oil and the holy incense.

questions.text: What was the altar of acacia wood at the start of this chapter for?
questions.explanation: Moses was told to make an altar to burn incense on, of acacia wood.

questions.text: When was Aaron to burn incense on this altar?
questions.explanation: Aaron was to burn sweet incense every morning when he tended the lamps, and at evening when he lit the lamps.

answers.text: Only at each new moon feast

questions.text: How often was atonement to be made on the horns of the incense altar?
questions.explanation: Aaron was to make atonement on its horns once in the year, with the blood of the sin offering of atonement.

questions.text: Why was each man to give a ransom when a census was taken?
questions.explanation: Each man was to give a ransom for his soul when counted, so that there would be no plague among them.

answers.text: To pay the soldiers of Israel
So there would be no plague
To buy land for the tribes
To feed the Levites and priests

questions.text: What amount was each counted man to give?
questions.explanation: Everyone counted was to give half a shekel, by the shekel of the sanctuary, as an offering to Yahweh.

questions.text: What was said about the rich and the poor and this offering?
questions.explanation: The rich were not to give more and the poor not to give less than the half shekel.

answers.text: The rich were to give double
The poor did not have to give
Rich and poor gave the same
Each gave as much as he wished

questions.text: What did Aaron and his sons wash in the bronze basin?
questions.explanation: Aaron and his sons were to wash their hands and their feet in the basin.

questions.text: Which of these was an ingredient of the holy anointing oil?
questions.explanation: The holy anointing oil was made with liquid myrrh, fragrant cinnamon, fragrant cane, cassia and olive oil.

questions.text: What would happen to anyone who made oil like the holy anointing oil?
questions.explanation: Whoever made any like it, or put any of it on a stranger, would be cut off from his people.

answers.text: He would have to offer a ram
He would be cut off from his people

questions.text: The holy incense was seasoned with what?
questions.explanation: The incense was a perfume after the art of the perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.
